description: The objects in a default list value get the defaults of their optional attributes
notes: The README says defaults populate missing optional attributes, without saying whether a default value it inserts gets the defaults of the objects in it. hashicorp/hcl converts each default value to its attribute's type when it reads the type (getType in ext/typeexpr/get_type.go), which turns [{}] into [{b = null}], and Defaults.apply (ext/typeexpr/defaults.go) applies the child defaults to that value, where b gets its default because a null attribute counts as missing (native/type-expressions/defaults-null-attribute).
